description: Recent Transfer events of an ERC-20 token (newest first, up to 50): tx, time, from, to, amount in token units. Optional holder filters to transfers from or to one wallet. Reads up to the last 12000 blocks (fewer on very busy tokens) via RPC, so it is cheap but not a full history; the response says what range was searched. Use for quick wallet or token activity checks. Price: $0.004 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"token":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","chain":"base","limit":5}.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche or optimism

holder.description: Optional wallet address to filter by
